cautions.label: all 368 ids of one gene
cautions.text: The 368 targets are the ids `ENSG00000012048.27` carries in RefSeq_mRNA at release 115. idtrack converts at the level of the gene: the identifier is read as its gene and followed as a gene, and the answer in the database asked is every id of the best gene there, not the counterpart of `NP_001395361` alone.
